node.statement: Corner identification and fixed-point step: lem-compcb-amplified-compression gives M_n tensor S_{P_1,Q_1}=S_{P_{1,n},Q_{1,n}}. Thus X lies in the image of Co_{P_{1,n},Q_{1,n}} by def-compressed-corner. Writing X=Co_{P_{1,n},Q_{1,n}}(Y), the idempotence supplied by lem-compcb-amplified-compression-identities gives Co_{P_{1,n},Q_{1,n}}(X)=Co_{P_{1,n},Q_{1,n}}^2(Y)=X.
